stage0052_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0052_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...That covers the whole account of the
　string of incidents we ran into in Paradigm City」

stage0052_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Well done, everyone.
　First, I'm glad to see you've all
　returned safely」

stage0052_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And, just as you all suspected,
　what I meant by the end of humanity's
　history is the 《$$エタニティ・フラット$$》」

stage0052_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Also, phenomena like the release of your
　sealed memories are being seen elsewhere」

stage0052_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ members absent here,
　plus 《$$スフィア$$》 and 《$$次元力$$》, is that it...」

stage0052_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our memories still aren't fully back,
　but recalling anything about $$スフィア|lc$$
　was still a real gain」

stage0052_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$'s memories have returned too.
　This should greatly advance hyperdimensional physics」

stage0052_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Though I suppose it's less a step forward
　than a return to how things should be」

stage0052_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'd say Geminis feared 《$$烙印$$》-bearers
　gathering, and $$スフィア|lc$$ and $$次元力|lc$$ existing」

stage0052_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Still, even for that reason,
　tampering with everyone's memories,
　and even stopping the world's time...」

stage0052_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「At the same time, it seems they also
　did something to the special powers
　held by $c's members」

stage0052_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Team D's members, $$キラ$$ and $$シン$$,
　Captain $$アムロ$$, $$カミーユ$$, and others,
　their suppressed powers were their doing too」

stage0052_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ＷＩＬＬ$$ believes that as their memories
　gradually return, their powers should
　reawaken as well」

stage0052_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オットー$$
「So Geminis' scheme is being unraveled, is it」

stage0052_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But it means nothing unless we break
　through $$エタニティ・フラット$$, humanity's
　greatest obstacle」

stage0052_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$... the Prison of Time...」

stage0052_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「First, let me explain the data
　$$ミスリル$$ has gathered」

stage0052_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Right now, the flow of time for life
　in this world lags about 2% behind normal」

stage0052_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So even after 100 minutes pass
　on the clock, our bodies have
　only experienced 98 of them...」

stage0052_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「At this level, almost no one should
　actually notice the difference」

stage0052_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「How did $$ミスリル$$ discover this?」

stage0052_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It started when pregnant women overdue
　worldwide began to rise in number」

stage0052_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$テッサ$$
「At the same time, Dr. $$トライア$$, who was
　studying $$次元力|lc$$, detected a shift in absolute
　time. Combining the two led us to $$エタニティ・フラット$$」

stage0052_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's about 98% now, but in the
　three months $$ガドライト$$ mentioned...」

stage0052_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The delay will keep growing.
　In two months most people will notice it,
　and in the final month it will hit zero」

stage0052_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$テッサ$$
「When that happens, living things will be
　left behind by time entirely, becoming things
　that neither age nor grow」

stage0052_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So plants won't grow, and animals,
　humans included, won't be able to bear young...」

stage0052_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, synthetic food could
　still force nutrition through somehow...」

stage0052_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But whether humanity could still build
　a future under such conditions remains in doubt」

stage0052_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Even without aging, death still comes,
　so humanity has no choice but to decline...」

stage0052_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「A future with no growth, no progress...
　That truly is the end of human history」

stage0052_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$オットー$$
「Still, I can't believe it...
　That something like this could happen」

stage0052_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$オットー$$
「What is it, Commander $$ブライト$$?」

stage0052_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I've seen a person fall into a state
　nearly identical to $$エタニティ・フラット$$」

stage0052_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That girl lived just like anyone else,
　but time stood still in her, her growth stopped」

stage0052_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's believed to be $$スフィア|lc$$'s power」

stage0052_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So $$次元力|lc$$... the laws themselves were rewritten?」

stage0052_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the $$新世時空震動$$ rewrote this world's
　laws, and that's what's causing $$エタニティ・フラット$$...」

stage0052_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「And it's no idle worry.
　It's becoming all too real」

stage0052_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$, what became of
　that girl whose time stopped!?」

stage0052_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Luckily, thanks to her positive nature and
　the help of those around her, she never gave up,
　and finally broke free of that curse-like state」

stage0052_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「And the power that saved her was $$次元力|lc$$ too」

stage0052_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So it all comes down to that...」

stage0052_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The time-lag is synced with the dimensional
　boundary locking in place. Our world is being cut
　off from all other dimensions as life's time stops」

stage0052_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then couldn't we break this open by
　causing something like a $$大時空震動$$...!?」

stage0052_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Indeed, that's true.
　...But humanity has no way to do that now」

stage0052_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And once the boundary fully locks in three
　months, we'll lose any chance to trigger
　a $$時空震動|lc$$ ourselves」

stage0052_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No... we must act before the delay is
　obvious to all, or there'll be panic among the people」

stage0052_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s leadership has already
　reported this matter to the $$大統領$$」

stage0052_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The Federal Assembly will surely deliberate
　carefully on a response, but the $$大統領$$ also
　intends to inform Neo Zeon's $$シャア・アズナブル$$」

stage0052_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ブライト$$
「This is no small matter.
　No time for humans to fight each other」

stage0052_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Since we can't trigger a $$大時空震動$$
　ourselves, the key to a breakthrough must be
　Geminis, the ones behind $$エタニティ・フラット$$」

stage0052_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, who called himself
　their captain, his power's still unknown, but
　he's unlike any enemy we've fought before」

stage0052_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But we have no choice but to chase him.
　If only to keep human history from ending」

stage0052_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Just as $$ロジャー$$ recovering his memories
　brought change to Paradigm City...」

stage0052_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「If only one turning point could let this
　world break the Prison of Time too...」

stage0052_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As for Mr. $$アドヴェント$$'s Chrono mentioned
　in the report, $$ミスリル$$ has no data on it either」

stage0052_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But given the matter of Point X as well,
　I'd like you all to head up into space
　as planned」

stage0052_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood.
　We'll leave the Chrono investigation to $$ミスリル$$」

stage0052_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ロジャー$$... you've been quiet a while.
　Do you have anything to say?」

stage0052_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...When it comes to Paradigm City,
　there's nothing I can say」

stage0052_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Unfortunately, right now I don't even know
　how to get back there, let alone how the city works」

stage0052_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I want you to look at this note
　that was left in my coat pocket」

stage0052_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「'Escape from the Ring of 12,000 Years'...
　$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$...」

stage0052_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$...
　Retired head of that big Paradigm City firm, right?」

stage0052_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And he's also the author of '$$メトロポリス$$'」

stage0052_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It takes the form of a novel, but supposedly
　it records the truth about this world」

stage0052_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's written as a tale of the past, but in
　a world where the $$大時空震動$$ swapped
　timelines, it can sometimes record the future」

stage0052_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Like a book of prophecy, or an 《$$アカシックレコード$$》」

stage0052_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Just like what Inspector $$加持$$ said of NERV's...）

stage0052_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$, who wrote
　'$$メトロポリス$$', is a man full of mysteries too」

stage0052_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I can't believe a note he went out
　of his way to leave behind means nothing」

stage0052_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The Ring of 12,000 Years...
　Seems that's another term worth remembering」

stage0052_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Commander Ikari said something similar too...）

stage0052_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What is it, Colonel Katsuragi?」

stage0052_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Since I don't know the Commander's intent,
　it's best not to act rashly now...）

stage0052_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$, Geminis, Chrono...
　and now the Ring of 12,000 Years too...」

stage0052_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Does space hold the key to those mysteries...」

stage0052_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So, that $$スフィア|lc$$ thing...
　it's a system for drawing out $$次元力|lc$$?」

stage0052_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「For now, that's the official line」

stage0052_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What do you mean by 'for now'?」

stage0052_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's still a lot we don't know
　about $$スフィア|lc$$ and $$次元力|lc$$」

stage0052_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$次元力|lc$$ pulls energy from another
　dimension into this world, and that's
　how it gets such huge output, right?」

stage0052_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$キラ$$
「That's the official story, but it's
　just the simplest use of $$次元力|lc$$」

stage0052_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$キラ$$
「According to Dr. $$トライア$$ at Scott Lab,
　$$次元力|lc$$'s true power is controlling events」

stage0052_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't quite get it, but does that
　mean you could do anything you want?」

stage0052_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$キラ$$
「Ultimately, yeah, that's the idea.
　Dr. $$トライア$$ called it rewriting
　the laws themselves, though...」

stage0052_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$キラ$$
「If you fully mastered $$次元力|lc$$,
　you could do literally anything, they say」

stage0052_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$時空震動|lc$$s apparently come from $$次元力|lc$$ too」

stage0052_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Then if we could control $$次元力|lc$$...!」

stage0052_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$シン$$
「We could probably break the Prison of Time too」

stage0052_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シン$$
「Like how 《$$メール$$》 broke free of $$スフィア|lc$$'s curse」

stage0052_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$メール$$... you mean Land's partner, $$メール$$?」

stage0052_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シン$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　Back during $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争|lc$$, $$メール$$
　was stuck with time frozen by $$スフィア|lc$$'s power」

stage0052_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$甲児$$
「So basically, she was in the same
　state as $$エタニティ・フラット$$...」

stage0052_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If $$エタニティ・フラット$$ really does complete,
　and humanity ends up living in frozen time...」

stage0052_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「...I don't even want to think about it...」

stage0052_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アルト$$
「It won't cause harm right away, but
　if that state lasted 10, or 100 years...」

stage0052_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Kids would stay kids forever...
　but their minds alone would keep aging」

stage0052_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「We'll just keep being Year 2 students... forever...」

stage0052_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「Grade schoolers just stay grade schoolers...
　Minds may grow, but bodies stay children forever...」

stage0052_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シン$$
「No person, no world could endure a thing like that」

stage0052_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$宗介$$
「Agreed.
　An endless quagmire of a battlefield...
　No different from a tomorrow that never comes」

stage0052_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$キラ$$
「People can't go on living in a world like that...」

stage0052_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$n
「Eaten away by despair and apathy,
　all that waits at the end is ruin, I'd guess...」

stage0052_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シン$$
「But if we can control $$次元力$$,
　we should be able to break through this」

stage0052_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$キラ$$
「During the $$再世戦争$$, research into $$次元力$$
　was far more advanced than it is now,
　enough to control events to some degree」

stage0052_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So that memory seal set back
　research into $$次元力$$ too, then」

stage0052_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$シン$$
「Now that Dr. $$トライア$$'s memory has returned,
　a $$スフィア$$ might be all we need to counter
　the $$エタニティ・フラット$$」

stage0052_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$n
「You know a lot. Did anyone
　from $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ or $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　ever actually see that $$スフィア$$?」

stage0052_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「Technically, a machine equipped with a $$スフィア$$」

stage0052_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アルト$$
「There are 12 $$スフィア$$s modeled on
　the zodiac, and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ had
　three of them」

stage0052_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$キラ$$
「Balgora Glory, the 'Maiden of Sorrow',
　Gunleon, the 'Scarred Lion',
　Li Vrasta, the 'Wavering Scales'...」

stage0052_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$キラ$$
「Those three pilots were called
　$$スフィア・リアクター$$s, gifted with the power
　to draw out a $$スフィア$$'s $$次元力$$」

stage0052_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シン$$
「Since Geminis sealed away the memories
　of $$スフィア$$ and $$次元力$$, we should assume
　those people aren't in this world anymore」

stage0052_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$キラ$$
「But I think they're fine.
　Those people, of all people, surely are」

stage0052_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$シン$$
（Setsuko...
　I believe we'll meet again, no matter what）

stage0052_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カレン$$
（Crowe and Land, of all people,
　aren't the type to die that easily）

stage0052_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$カレン$$
（$$エスター$$...
　You're doing fine somewhere too, aren't you...）

stage0052_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$甲児$$
「Those aren't the only $$スフィア$$s we know of.
　In the $$再世戦争$$, we fought the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s
　'False Black Ram' and 'Endless Water Jar'」

stage0052_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So the people who hold a $$スフィア$$
　aren't necessarily on our side...」

stage0052_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$シン$$
「The power itself isn't good or evil.
　It's up to whoever wields it」

stage0052_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「Maiden, Lion, Scales, Ram, Water Bearer...
　Seven $$スフィア$$s left, then...」

stage0052_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Feels like I already knew a few of those...」

stage0052_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess I can't quite remember
　because the memory seal isn't fully undone...」

stage0052_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アルト$$
（Looking at $$アマタ$$... at Aquarion,
　something nags at me...）

stage0052_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Still, $$スフィア$$ sounds pretty romantic.
　Like something out of horoscopes」

stage0052_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$キラ$$
「Close enough, actually.
　...$$次元力$$ is apparently stellar energy at its root」

stage0052_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$キラ$$
「The zodiac's 12 signs formed from the
　galaxy's strongest stars, and Earth, orbiting
　among them, is ideal for drawing out $$次元力$$」

stage0052_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$甲児$$
「So that's why aliens keep targeting Earth」

stage0052_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Maybe that's why the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　showed up on Earth too」

stage0052_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$宗介$$
「But... are you sure, Chidori?
　Coming all the way out to space」

stage0052_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Nothing scares me anymore,
　not after coming back from Paradigm City」

stage0052_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, if not for a chance like this,
　I'd never get to come to space」

stage0052_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You've got some nerve, you do」

stage0052_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But be careful, Chidori.
　You're still a civilian, after all」

stage0052_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm grateful for your help,
　but don't get in too deep」

stage0052_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So, $n and $$ジェニオン$$ concern you, huh」

stage0052_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ジェニオン$$ aside, I can't help but
　think $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s uncanny power
　comes from $$次元力$$」

stage0052_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ロジャー$$ said he too senses
　something from $$ジェニオン$$'s presence」

stage0052_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Could it be that $n is...」

stage0052_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't go speaking on wishful thinking」

stage0052_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And if $$ジェニオン$$ has a $$スフィア$$ in it,
　$n might end up walking as harsh a road
　as Setsuko and the others did...」

stage0052_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Should be about time for the target point」

stage0052_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Just like last time, what's waiting for us
　might be a sudden $$時空震動$$」

stage0052_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Don't go scaring me like that!」

stage0052_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「What's wrong, $$ギミー$$?
　Getting cold feet?」

stage0052_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ギミー$$
「There you go, treating us like kids again!」

stage0052_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ダリー$$
「We're full-fledged warriors defending Earth now」

stage0052_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My bad, my bad.
　I just can't shake the image I've got
　of you two as little kids」

stage0052_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Can't blame him.
　$$竜馬$$ skipped past watching you two grow up
　and met you again already all grown」

stage0052_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シモン$$
「But I'll vouch for you.
　You're both proper Dai-Gurren Brigade members now」

stage0052_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If the leader himself says so,
　I've got no choice but to accept it」

stage0052_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Guess I've gotta live up to that, then」

stage0052_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$キャシー$$
「$cAll hands. We've confirmed a distortion
　in the dimensional boundary at the target point」

stage0052_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Guess it went just like $$ヴィラル$$ said!」

stage0052_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Well, $$ギミー$$?
　Good thing you braced yourself, huh」

stage0052_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「$cAll ships, proceed to the site
　to confirm the situation」

stage0052_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$キャシー$$
「All hands, prepare to launch
　in case of an emergency」

stage0052_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$シモン$$
「After Paradigm City, what on earth
　is waiting for us this time...」

stage0052_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on.
　Guess I'll see it with my own eyes」

stage0052_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I should've been swallowed by the $$インベーダー#keyword$$,
　so why am I in space...!?」

stage0052_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Cocky bastard...!
　What business do you have with me!?」

stage0052_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$竜馬$$
「What are you talking about...!
　That's rich, coming from a guy talking in his sleep!」

stage0052_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
???
「The universe of reincarnation nears its end...
　Accept your own mission」

stage0052_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$竜馬$$
「...This heat welling up deep in my body...
　Is that what you mean?」

stage0052_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
???
「That's right.
　You're fated to live within an endless fight...」

stage0052_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
???
「Come with me.
　You're not allowed to rot away here」

stage0052_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
???
「This is not where you're meant to fight.
　You're not allowed to rot away here」

stage0052_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't screw with me!
　Don't go killing me off on your own!」

stage0052_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Too bad for you!
　If you think getting swallowed by an
　$$インベーダー#keyword$$ could kill me, think again!」

stage0052_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Screw that mission crap!
　I just live by what my own heart tells me!!」

stage0052_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Anyone who gets in my way, I'll crush!
　Even if it's Getter itself!!」

stage0052_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$キタン$$
「Yo, you two!
　You doing all right?」

stage0052_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$キタン$$
「W, what's with that face?
　This $$キタン$$ came all this way,
　and that's the silent type for you!」

stage0052_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't take it personally.
　$$宗介$$'s always like this」

stage0052_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「A new face since $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　became $c, huh」

stage0052_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Been waiting for you, $$ヨーコ$$!」

stage0052_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「So you're $$ミスリル$$'s $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$.
　I've heard the rumors」

stage0052_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Man, with $$ヨーコ$$ here,
　the sniper team's finally got some flair」

stage0052_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Now we can finally say goodbye
　to that 'Snoopers' nickname」

stage0052_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Isn't that just what you had coming...」

stage0052_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Sorry, $$クルツ$$.
　I don't do womanizers」

stage0052_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$キタン$$
「That's how it is, newbie.
　Lay a hand on $$ヨーコ$$, and you'll answer for it」

stage0052_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$クルツ$$
（You're serious about $$ヨーコ$$, aren't you?）

stage0052_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Don't worry about it.
　Believe it or not, I'm a man of honor）

stage0052_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Besides, it's a sniper's nature.
　I want to back a man who's serious）

stage0052_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$キタン$$
（You... you're a surprisingly good guy!）

stage0052_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$クルツ$$
（If you're serious, bro, I'll help you out
　with $$ヨーコ$$-chan）

stage0052_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$クルツ$$
（So what are you gonna do?
　Gonna just stand there and watch
　that gorgeous, selfish body of hers?）

stage0052_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$キタン$$
（$$クルツ$$!
　I'm counting on you, man to man!!）

stage0052_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$クルツ$$
（OK, $$キタン$$.
　From today, we're brothers）

stage0052_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$クルツ$$-kun... what are you being
　so sneaky about?」

stage0052_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$マオ$$
「Knowing him, it's obviously some
　no-good scheme」

stage0052_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Easy now, $$キタン$$.
　A man's gotta grit his teeth and bear it」

stage0052_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Then, when it counts, charge straight in!」

stage0052_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$キタン$$
「Right!
　When that time comes, I'll end it in one shot!」

stage0052_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Oh well, fine.
　Seems like you two get along now, anyway」

stage0052_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Huh, not just $$ギミー$$ and $$ダリー$$'s,
　your Gunmen got fitted for space too」

stage0052_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$キタン$$
「You bet!
　It's the Dai-Gurren Brigade mechanics' pride and joy!」

stage0052_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「It was originally supposed to be bigger,
　but we settled on this size for handling」

stage0052_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So $$ロシウ$$'s watching for threats from space, huh」

stage0052_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$隼人$$
「That's right.
　That's why we broke Shin Getter's seal, too」

stage0052_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$弁慶$$
「$$號$$ and the others are getting ready
　to activate the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$」

stage0052_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$シモン$$
「Now that the $$インベーダー#keyword$$s are attacking Earth again,
　we need to beef up our own strength too」

stage0052_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$キタン$$
「$$シモン$$... I've got a message for you
　guys from $$ロージェノム$$」

stage0052_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Ruler of the Beastmen who governed the
　$$暗黒大陸$$, the Spiral King $$ロージェノム$$...」

stage0052_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Though he lost the war against humanity,
　he's since been revived as a gene-grown
　bio-computer, and now aids the government」

stage0052_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$隼人$$
「He said 《$$バアル$$》 is coming soon」

stage0052_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「《$$バアル$$》...
　The ones called mankind's natural enemy...」

stage0052_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$マオ$$
「Are today's $$インベーダー#keyword$$s part of
　this whole $$バアル$$ thing too?」

stage0052_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$隼人$$
「But if they specifically called it $$バアル$$,
　then what's coming might not be just
　$$インベーダー#keyword$$s」

stage0052_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So then, what $$アドヴェント$$-san was
　trying to tell us was...」

stage0052_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$宗介$$
「Yeah...
　No doubt it's $$バアル$$ making its appearance」

stage0052_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Give me a break...
　One batch of monsters was already a no-thanks」

stage0052_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シモン$$
「Earth's crisis keeps escalating faster and faster...」

stage0052_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「If we're careless, humanity itself
　might end before the end of human history does...」

stage0052_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ギミー$$
「They say a huge robot came out of that
　ice block $$竜馬$$-san recovered!」

stage0052_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ダリー$$
「That's not all.
　They say the woman in its cockpit is alive too」

stage0052_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$竜馬$$
「A robot frozen in ice, and its pilot...」

stage0052_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's all the data on $$エタニティ・フラット$$」

stage0052_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Commander Ikari...
　Do you know of a book called '$$メトロポリス$$'?」

stage0052_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「First I've heard of it」

stage0052_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I see.
　Then please forget I asked」

stage0052_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「As for $$エタニティ・フラット$$, since NERV
　has no way to handle it ourselves,
　we'll follow the Federal Government's lead」

stage0052_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood.
　Let's each do everything we can for
　this world. Now, if you'll excuse me」

stage0052_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$冬月$$
「...So she's the real head of
　$$ミスリル$$'s field unit, then」

stage0052_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「On top of that, there's word she's
　a $$ウィスパード$$ as well」

stage0052_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$冬月$$
「What do you make of her reason for
　contacting us?」

stage0052_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$ is likely just a pretext.
　Her real target is $$メトロポリス$$」

stage0052_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$冬月$$
「Does $$ミスリル$$ know the Dead Sea Scrolls exist?」

stage0052_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Probably.
　We've obtained their information too,
　so they're likely doing the same」

stage0052_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$冬月$$
「But their goal is world peace, huh...
　Sounds just like your son's club activities」

stage0052_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$冬月$$
「So... what do you intend to do?」

stage0052_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There's no particular need to act.
　Everything is going according to schedule」

stage0052_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$冬月$$
「So neither the end of human history nor
　$$バアル$$'s coming matters to you...」

stage0052_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That's right.
　This is where the 120,000,000-year cycle closes...
　the edge of myth, after all」

stage0052_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of the famous Getter Team.
　Dropping in and having all three of you
　shoot down an enemy each is no small feat」

stage0052_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Nothing to be surprised about.
　Each of us is a one-in-a-thousand specialist」

stage0052_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the leader here, Master $$竜馬$$, is the strongest?」

stage0052_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$'s only leader as a formality」

stage0052_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$竜馬$$
「What, you two...
　Got a problem with that?」

stage0052_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Not interested in being leader, not at this point」

stage0052_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$隼人$$
「But letting you call yourself the
　Getter Team's strongest, that I can't stand」

stage0052_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... you old geezers.
　Don't think you can beat me now」

stage0052_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$隼人$$
「We've got ten years of experience you
　don't have... we'll make you feel it」

stage0052_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on!
　As our reunion greeting, let's settle this for good!」

stage0052_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Good... so good!
　This is exactly the development I hoped for!）

stage0052_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Three fighting spirits clashing births Z-Chips...!
　At this rate, 100Z is a sure thing!）

stage0052_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（I'll add the Z-Chips to the squad's
　stock, so please, everyone, go all out.
　As for me, I'll be evacuating...）

stage0052_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I recovered the $$ブラックゲッター$$ Master $$竜馬$$ used,
　but I'm not sure what to do with it...」

stage0052_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Well, he was the one piloting it.
　No wonder」

stage0052_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since Master $$竜馬$$ switched to the
　$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, this one's served its
　purpose, so scrapping it is an option...」

stage0052_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$カレン$$
「What! That's such a waste!
　And it's black, too!」

stage0052_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「She's right.
　It'd be a shame to scrap such fine black」

stage0052_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Black is good...
　It's full of elegance, and yet it
　conveys a will that bows to no one」

stage0052_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$カレン$$
「Both red and black are cool, you know.
　Even $$竜馬$$-san who rides red might
　feel like riding black again sometime」

stage0052_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood.
　Then let's add extra cockpits so Master
　$$隼人$$ and Master $$弁慶$$ can ride along too」

stage0052_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... but if I refit the Getter,
　who'll guide the D-Trader...」

stage0052_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you'll show black some respect,
　we'll fill in for you」

stage0052_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$カレン$$
「Alright, let's give it our all today too!」
